title: Curved Geometry
description: Drop the fifth postulate and parallel lines may meet, or spread apart: the geometry of a sphere, or of a saddle. Gauss measured mountain triangles to see which one we live in.

puzzle.goal: A triangle is drawn on a sphere of radius R and covers an area A. Write the sum S of its three angles.
puzzle.name: Spherical excess
puzzle.ask: Find S for A = @{A} and R = @{R} (one eighth of the sphere: three right angles).
puzzle.method: The angles add to π on a plane; on a sphere they exceed it by the area divided by R² (Girard).
